description: Rigid-body debris field — rock, concrete, metal fragments distributed outward from explosion epicenter. Adds ground-level detail and cinematic scale.

orchestration_stages.label: Debris Source Geometry
orchestration_stages.description: Create or reference the source geometry that will be fractured.
orchestration_hints: Use existing structural geometry if available. Otherwise use a sphere or box as proxy.

orchestration_stages.label: Voronoi Fracture
orchestration_stages.description: Procedurally fracture source geometry into debris pieces with scale variation.
orchestration_hints: Low density fracture (10–30 pieces) for hero chunks.
High density fracture (200–1000 pieces) for fine rubble.
Use two-pass fracture for scale variation.
artistic_constraints: Minimum 3 scale categories: hero (0.3–2.0m), mid (0.05–0.3m), fine (<0.05m).
Scale distribution: 5% hero, 25% mid, 70% fine by count.
Interior faces should have different material from exterior.

orchestration_stages.label: Initial Velocity Distribution
orchestration_stages.description: Apply initial outward velocity to debris pieces from epicenter.
orchestration_hints: Speed variation: 8–20 m/s for hero, 15–40 m/s for fine.
Add random angular velocity for tumbling.
artistic_constraints: Large pieces: lower speed (8–15 m/s) — heavy.
Fine particles: higher speed (20–40 m/s) — light.
No pieces should have zero velocity.

orchestration_stages.label: Rigid Body Simulation
orchestration_stages.description: Simulate RBD physics with terrain collision and piece-to-piece interaction.
artistic_constraints: All pieces must have tumbling rotation on first ground contact.
Secondary bounce required for hero chunks.
Pieces must settle — simulation minimum 60 frames after impact.

orchestration_stages.label: Fine Particle Scatter Distribution
orchestration_stages.description: Add scattered fine particles for dense near-field rubble field.
orchestration_hints: Use scatter SOP to place instanced fine pieces on ground near epicenter.
Density falls off with distance from epicenter.

orchestration_stages.label: Debris Dust Trails
orchestration_stages.description: Thin dust trails from large hero chunks as they fly through air.
artistic_constraints: Only on hero chunks (>0.3m) — not fine particles.
Rapid dissipation — trail should not outlast piece travel time.

review_expectations.scale_variation: Three clearly distinct scale categories visible.
review_expectations.motion: All pieces tumble — no translation-only motion.
review_expectations.distribution: Uneven spatial distribution — not radially uniform.
review_expectations.distance_scaling: Largest pieces near camera, finest far.
review_expectations.secondary_bounce: Hero chunks bounce on ground contact.
review_expectations.dust_trails: Large pieces leave visible dust trails.
